claims: Madagascar is the world's fourth-largest island.
Madagascar is located off the coast of Southeast Africa.
Madagascar is a biodiversity hotspot.
The capital of Madagascar is Antananarivo.
The population of Madagascar is over 22 million.
The population of Madagascar is largely engaged in agriculture.
Malagasy and French are the official languages of Madagascar.
Madagascar is known as the "Great Red Island".
Madagascar features tropical rainforests along the coast.
Madagascar features dry forests in the south.
Madagascar features mountainous terrain in the central highlands.
Antananarivo is high-altitude.
Over 90% of Madagascar's wildlife is found nowhere else on Earth.
Madagascar separated from the African continent roughly 160 million years ago.
The population of Madagascar is heavily influenced by Indonesian roots.
Madagascar is considered a least-developed country.
The official currency of Madagascar is the Malagasy Ariary.
Euros are often accepted in tourist areas of Madagascar.
Christianity is the predominant religion in Madagascar.
The Avenue of the Baobabs is a baobab tree-lined road.
Tsingy de Bemaraha National Park is known for its unique sharp limestone known as "tsingy".
Isalo National Park features sandstone formations and canyons.
Nosy Be is an island destination for beaches and diving.
